title: Module and derived lifts of the pullback-from-point comparison
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and let $f:T\to X$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $p_Y^*$ be inverse image from the point for $Y=T,X$ [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point], let $\Lambda_Y=p_Y^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and let $\varphi:f^{-1}p_X^*\xrightarrow{\sim}p_T^*$ be the monoidal comparison on abelian sheaves [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point-comp]. Its coefficient component is the ring isomorphism $\alpha_f:f^{-1}\Lambda_X\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda_T$ [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms]. Write $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda}$ for module objects on the point and $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_Y}$ for module objects on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Denote by $p_{Y,\Lambda}^*:\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda}\to\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_Y}$ the functor transporting the module action along $p_Y^*$ [sk-def-sfb-transport], and by $f_\Lambda^*$ module inverse image with coefficient map $\alpha_f$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations].

For every $\Lambda$-module object $M$, $\varphi_M$ is $\Lambda_T$-linear when the $f^{-1}\Lambda_X$-action on $f^{-1}p_X^*M$ is transported by $\alpha_f$. Thus these specified underlying maps give a natural isomorphism of exact module functors
$$\Phi:f_\Lambda^*\circ p_{X,\Lambda}^*\xrightarrow{\sim}p_{T,\Lambda}^*.$$
Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with module sheaves identified with internal module objects [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Applying $\Phi$ termwise and localizing at quasi-isomorphisms induces a natural isomorphism
$$L f_\Lambda^*\circ D(p_{X,\Lambda}^*)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(p_{T,\Lambda}^*),$$
whose component on every represented unbounded complex is the localization of the chain isomorphism with degree-$n$ component $\varphi_{M^n}$. No flatness, boundedness or finiteness assumption on $M$ or its representing complex is required.

proof.text: The existing profinite-to-pro-etale functor is representably flat. Its opposite left Kan extension preserves finite limits because filtered colimits in abelian groups are exact; shrink AB5 to the comma-category universe. Sheaf inclusion and sheafification preserve finite limits, giving left exactness of pointUpperStar. Compose with the exact inverse image along the structure morphism. Apply the existing preservesFiniteLimits_mapMod instance to obtain the point-module finite-limit instance.

proof.text: Compose pointUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction with the scheme inverse-image adjunction. Its left adjoint preserves colimits, hence finite colimits. The existing preservesFiniteColimits_mapMod instance lifts this to point modules. An additive-category functor preserving binary coproducts preserves binary biproducts, hence is additive. This proves the other two point-module instances.

proof.text: Use the module morphism axiom of the component of Functor.mapModCompIso for upperStarFromPointComp. It states a_N followed by phi_M equals f^{-1}(Lambda_X) whisker phi_M followed by alpha_f whisker P and a_P. Precompose by alpha_f inverse whisker N. The tensor interchange law moves this inverse past phi_M; composition of right whiskers and alpha_f inverse followed by alpha_f = identity cancel the coefficient factors. This is exactly the displayed linearity identity for restriction along alpha_f inverse. All isomorphisms and module actions are the existing constructions.

proof.text: The existing scheme module inverse image preserves finite limits and colimits and is additive, so the given definition of the derived comparison is well-typed. Set F = point-module pullback and G = scheme module pullback. Expand only the composite of natural isomorphisms in the definition. Apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac to the existing upperStarFromPointModComp. Apply mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac to F, G and K. A private proved category lemma precomposes this identity by the inverse composition map and cancels the inverse-hom composite, then postcomposes with the localized chain comparison. This replaces the remaining inverse-composition/factorization pair by the iterated factorizations and the image of mapHomologicalComplexCompIso. Associativity gives exactly the stated normalization, for every unbounded complex. The final definitional conversion is proved structurally by congruence and proof irrelevance, after reducing composite functor objects; it reconciles direct and abelian-inherited preadditive instances in proof arguments. The resulting proof is kernel checked.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q156-f38047e48 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item in full; there are no new nodes. The statement matches HRS 2305.18131 §3 pp.5-6 ('Λ_Y = f^{-1}Λ_X, f^* = f^{-1} exact'), with nothing added or dropped. The coefficient categories are internal Λ_Y-modules identified with sectionwise modules by def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence. The base-change morphism is def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations with c = α_f, and α_f is the Λ-component of sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point-comp. No SGA source is used. Fault 1 (E1/C4), Step 1: lem-weil-pbc-site-pullback-abelian-exact assumes a morphism of sites, i.e. u_s exact on sets (Stacks 00X6), which sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point does not supply. Fixed by citing lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-site-inverse-image-tensor (u preserves finite limits and coverings, so sheafified Lan is exact; its unit sk-thm-properbasechange is on the route) together with lem-sfb-finite-upper-star-exact for π_Y^*. Fault 2 (C1/C4), Steps 4 and 6: det-prop-sfb-module-pullback-exact-main is about the internal Ext_{α_f}∘mapMod(f^{-1}), but the statement's f_Λ^* and Lf_Λ^* are the sectionwise functors of def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations transported along E, and the proof never identified the two. Fixed by citing lem-sfb-internal-module-operations-transport (E_T f^*_int ≅ f^*_sec E_X, with f^*_sec = B_T⊗_{f^{-1}B_X}f^{-1}(−)) and transporting it to D by the already-cited lem-sfb-exact-derived-natural-iso and lem-sfb-exact-derived-composition. Steps 2, 3 and 5 are correct. Step 2: change-of-scalars clause 5 hypotheses hold and Ext_α ≅ Res_{α^{-1}}. Step 3: restricted-transport linearity with ψ = 1, ψ' = α^{-1}, φ = 1; the condition αα^{-1} = 1 holds, and linearity of the inverse and naturality follow. Step 5: D(Φ) has the stated normalization. Edge cases checked: Λ = 0, T empty, f = id, complexes unbounded in both directions. No duplicate in the DAG (searched the citers of pullback-from-point-comp) and no cycle (the closure of the newly cited nodes excludes the item). proof_deps and split_report.tool_uses are updated in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-zeta-weil/lem-zl-condensed-point-module-comparison.json.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
